overview_description.description:
JumpWire makes it easy to enforce secure data practices across applications without having to change any code. By proxying requests to databases and APIs and inspecting their schemas and payloads, JumpWire automatically identifies fields that need special handling. JumpWire will transform the data in place (for example encrypting any field that is classified as PII). This ensures that further processing or storage won’t risk leaking the data in its raw form inadvertently.

A common use case for JumpWire is moving data between internal databases and tools for analytics and customer support. In this scenario, specific columns (such as those corresponding to PII) may need special handling before loading into another tool with a more permissive access concept.

JumpWire installs on-premise or inside our customer’s own cloud, so there is no dependency on a third party or concern with sharing data outside the network.

about_short_description.short_description: JumpWire makes it easy to enforce secure data practices across applications without having to change any code.

product.name: Database Gateway
product.description: A reverse proxy that sits in front of databases to manage access control, query routing, encryption, and logging/auditing without requiring changes to the backend.

product.name: Privileged Access Management
product.description: Replaces static passwords with SSO and maps privileges to employee roles and other attributes, ensuring data confidentiality.

product.name: Field-Level Encryption
product.description: Encrypts specific data fields to prevent sensitive information like credit card numbers from being read as plain text.

product.name: Enforced Query Filters
product.description: Ensures all queries contain filter clauses and provides guardrails for queries generated by third-party software and LLMs.

product.name: Query Execution Control
product.description: Blocks unauthorized queries and modifies data that should not be handled as plain text by masking or tokenizing fields.

product.name: Transparent Data Routing
product.description: Manages data storage across multiple regions to comply with residency laws and allows joining data across regions in a single request.
